lines.en: Joey, where are the Jell-O shots?
I don't know. Chandler was supposed to be passing them in...
Chandler!
Hello, Jell-O!
Oh, somebody's feeling better.
Stick out your tongue.
Take off your shirt.
- Oh, my. - Oh, my God.
How many of these did you have? These are pure vodka.
Yeah, Jell-O, just like Mom used to make.
- Joey! - Joey, here's your daddy!
Okay, how many of that girl are you seeing?
How hammered are you, huh? These are Joey's sisters.
Hi, Joey's sisters.
What you doing?
I'm taking my ex-girlfriend off my speed dialer.
- Aww. - No, no, no, no, no, it's a good thing.
Why must we dial so speedily anyway?
Why must we rush through life?
Why can't we savor the precious moments?
Those are some huge breasts you have.
